title: 第19章 行动开始第20章 大捷
slug: 异世界开局俘虏女骑士
lines: 闹腾的人走了，村里安静了不少。
齐格飞正在坐在司令部翻阅着漫游手册。
说是司令部其实就是杂货间收拾出来摆上一张桌子，上面放了一张就算毕加索在世也不一定能够看得懂的抽象地图。
齐格飞当然不会真的用这种东西查看地形，这只是营造一种运筹帷幄的格调，漫游手册上的信息才是关键。
这段时间他用搜索功能查阅了王国的地图、历史以及奇兰大陆上的各种知识。
就如他前天在教堂里说的那样，他是不会上前线干架的，只会在幕后出谋划策。这些知识储备就是为了更好谋划未来。
这时司令部的房门被打开，圃人波波端着一杯香气四溢的咖啡放到齐格飞的办公桌上。
风桃村当然是没有咖啡的，这是齐格飞从地球上带来的，因为带的不多所以他总是藏起来偷偷喝，免得被卡塔丽娜那货闻到香味跑来分一杯羹。
波波现在已经成了齐格飞专用仆人，负责伺候齐格飞的日常起居。
原本罗兰是想把这可恶的叛徒一刀砍死的，不过在齐格飞的极力劝说下保住了小命。
这倒不是齐格飞圣母心发作，这男人压根就没那种东西。
而是他个人挺欣赏波波的，这个圃人演技绝佳能力出众，居然能在罗兰的眼皮底下瞒那么久。
瞒住罗兰也就算了，居然连克琳希德也让他蒙了过去，克琳希德的神迹可是能看破谎言的。这足见这位圃人斥候的手段高明。
齐格飞觉得目前阵营人才匮乏，任何有用的人都要尽可能留着。
当然还有一点私心，这个波波长得矮胖矮胖的，和他在公司里的那位前辈大哥有些颇有些相像，让齐格飞有种异界遇故知的亲近感。
这么想着，齐格飞笑着叫住了正要离开的波波：
“波波，先别走你过来，我有事问你。”
波波打了一个激灵，僵硬地转过身，极度不情愿的一小步一小步地挪了过去。
显然小波波完全不想和齐格飞亲近。
“大人，您有什么事要问小的？”波波嗓音尖锐刺耳，据说是以前因为某件事嗓子受伤才变成这样的。
“哦，也不是什么大事。我就是好奇你之前是怎么瞒过克琳希德和罗兰的？”
齐格飞笑容可掬，像极了一个开明宽厚的领导。
“方便说一说吗，不方便的话，也请你说一说。”
（狗屎！这不是完全没给我选择吗！）
波波在心中怒骂，但脸上依旧恭恭敬敬。
“其实，小的这半年一直都是跟着卡塔丽娜大人的，从没见过王女殿下和罗兰大人。”波波露出了回忆的表情。
“为保安全，殿下一路上都待在马车里，小的也是在进入康斯顿伯爵领后才和卡塔丽娜大人一起面见殿下的。“
波波说了半天都不见齐格飞回应，有些疑惑地抬头望去。
这一看，着实把波波吓了一跳。
齐格飞的脸色阴沉得几乎能滴出水。
“你刚刚说什么。”
波波扑通一声就跪了下来。
“大人，大人饶命啊大人，小的所说句句属实啊，您可以问问卡塔丽娜大人啊，她能证明的。”
齐格飞没有理会他抓起椅背上的黑袍直接冲出了房间。
（该死！该死！为什么我会没有意识到！）
他飞奔往克琳希德的房间却没有找到人，只有村里的大婶正在打扫房间。
“阿姨，克琳希德在哪里！”齐格飞对着大婶急迫地问道。
“王女殿下今天和老约翰他们一起去附近打猎了，小齐格，出什么事了吗？”大婶发现齐格飞的脸色难看，也紧张了起来。
（怎么偏偏这时候出去了！）
content_en:
The noisy people left, and the village became much quieter.
Siegfried was sitting in the headquarters, flipping through the Hitchhiker's Manual.
It was said that the headquarters was actually a table in the general store, with an abstract map on it that Picasso might not be able to understand even if he were alive.
Of course, Siegfried would not actually use this kind of thing to check the terrain. It was just to create a strategizing style. The information in the Hitchhiker's Manual was the key.
During this time, he used the search function to consult the kingdom's map, history, and various knowledge on the Qilan continent.
As he said in the church the day before yesterday, he will not go to the front line to fight, but will only make suggestions behind the scenes. This knowledge reserve is for better planning for the future.
At this time, the door of the headquarters was opened, and Bobo, a nurse, placed a cup of fragrant coffee on Siegfried's desk.
Of course there is no coffee in Fengtao Village. Siegfried brought it from Earth. Since he didn't bring much, he always hid it and drank it secretly, lest Katarina smell the fragrance and come to get a share of the coffee.
Bobo has now become Siegfried's special servant, responsible for taking care of Siegfried's daily life.
Roland originally wanted to kill this hateful traitor with a knife, but he managed to save his life after Siegfried's strong persuasion.
This wasn't Siegfried having a heart attack, this man didn't have that kind of thing at all.
But he personally admires Bobo. This native has excellent acting skills and is able to hide it from Roland for so long.
Even if he had to hide it from Roland, he even managed to hide it from Clinehid, whose miraculous ability could see through lies. This shows that this gardener scout is very clever.
Siegfried felt that the current camp was lacking in talents, and any useful people should be retained as much as possible.
Of course, there is also a little selfishness. This wave has a short and fat appearance, which is somewhat similar to his senior brother in the company, giving Siegfried a sense of intimacy as if he meets an old friend from another world.
Thinking this, Siegfried smiled and stopped Bobo who was about to leave:
"Bobo, don't leave yet. Come here. I have something to ask you."
Bobo shuddered, turned around stiffly, and moved over step by step with extreme reluctance.
Obviously little Bobo doesn't want to get close to Siegfried at all.
"Sir, what do you have to ask me?" Bobo's voice was sharp and harsh. It is said that it was like this because of an injury to his throat in the past.
"Oh, it's not a big deal. I'm just curious how you managed to hide it from Clinhilde and Roland before?"
Siegfried smiled broadly, like an enlightened and generous leader.
"Is it convenient for you to tell me? If not, please tell me."
(Shit! Doesn’t this give me no choice at all!)
Bobo cursed in his heart, but his face remained respectful.
"Actually, I have been following Lady Katarina for the past six months and have never seen Her Royal Highness or Lord Roland." Bobo showed a recalling expression.
"To ensure safety, His Highness stayed in the carriage all the way. The younger one only met His Highness with Lady Catalina after entering the Count of Constant."
Bobo didn't see Siegfried's response after talking for a long time, so he looked up in confusion.
This sight really startled Bobo.
Siegfried's face was so gloomy that he could almost drip with water.
"What did you just say?"
Bobo knelt down with a plop.
"Sir, please spare my life, my lord. Everything I said is true. You can ask Katarina-sama, she can prove it."
Siegfried ignored him and grabbed the black robe on the back of the chair and rushed out of the room.
(Damn! Damn! Why didn’t I realize it!)
He rushed to Clinehid's room but found no one, only the village aunt was cleaning the room.
"Auntie, where is Clinhilde!" Siegfried asked his aunt urgently.
"Her Royal Highness went hunting nearby with Old John and the others today. Little Sieg, what happened?" The aunt noticed that Siegfried's face looked ugly and she became nervous.
(Why did you go out at this time!)
